name: Chen Lin Education Group Holdings Limited
summary: Chen Lin Education Group Holdings Limited provides private tertiary education services in the People's Republic of China. The company operates Jiangxi Institute of Applied Science and Technology, a private university that offers undergraduate and junior college programs, as well as diverse education related services. It also operates Jiangxi Wenli Jishi College, a full-time vocational college; Guizhou Vocational College of Industry and Trade, a higher vocational college; and Chen Lin High School, a private high school. In addition, the company is involved in investment related activities. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Nanchang, the People's Republic of China.
